page.notes: Marginal notes are partly Arabic and partly illegible in the scan; the Arabic readings in the notes and the Arabic in the text (e.g. مثل ما يصاحب, لا عدوى) are approximate and should be checked against the original. The left-margin notes are placed beside the lines where they stand; the exact Arabic in the second note is uncertain: "مجاوزة من صاحبه الى غيره" is inferred. The note "v & Kimus" is uncertain in its first letter. The Arabic in the line "وقد ابطله الاسلام" is uncertain. The word "scabie" is set with a hyphen-like break in the scan ("miscer-ri"), read as "miscere ri" where the scan shows "miscer- ri"; the printed text is taken as "miscere ri" per the scan. No catchword, signature or footer visible. Line 2 of the left margin "صفر &c." is uncertain.
